scope: Variable gallery size with unchanged selected M arithmetic and uniform aligned thresholds
key_family: Same actual client family and ordinary server key within process; extra M keys derived once from that client
fresh_query_encryptions: two per block, including unused legacy52 at candidate-only sizes; same clear query, independently encrypted native formats
timing_boundary: planning, prefix, LUT setup and complete core call; all arms finish before decryption, output serialization or hashing
primary_comparison: M/A126 within same scene/key block; report per-key log-ratio means and all raw pairs
uncertainty: Exploratory Student-t 95% interval on three independent key mean log ratios, df=2; assumptions explicit; no independent-pair bootstrap
contamination_policy: Retain and label overlaps; report all paired results and any clean subset separately without silently replacing keys or rerunning favorable subsets
